activity_summary: You looked at the mended sleeve on the parlour table. The new seam is finer than the old. No face is in it, and neither is a hand. You are not in the picture.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the table. Not pictured.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Her work is the sleeve. Her face is not in the picture.

facets.activity: Looked at the finer seam on the sleeve
